name: [2X + UPDATE] Project: Beatdown
desc:
A fighting game. Not based on any anime or something else.

-Many bugfixes.

Controls:
B to execute
Q to dash
Right click to heavy attack
F to block
Double Tap W to run

You can farm money using pizza delivery mission.
You can grind attack speed and speed in gym.
Gym is 90 money per minute. If you don't stay in, it doesn't count.

Game isn't done, so expect bugs or not enough concept.
